name: n8n
summary: Workflow automation platform combining AI agents and integrations.
description: n8n is a workflow automation platform that combines AI agents with hundreds of app integrations and custom code, giving technical teams the flexibility of code with the speed of no-code. Its differentiator is that it can be self-hosted (free Community Edition) as well as used in the cloud. Cloud plans come with a free trial.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Free when self-hosted, then $20/mo (Starter, billed annually)
pricing.note_fr: Gratuit en auto-hébergement, puis 20 $/mois (Starter, facturé annuellement)

howToUse.title: Get started
howToUse.description: The homepage says to get started and describes n8n as the platform for agents and workflows you can follow.

howToUse.title: Build the workflow
howToUse.description: The page says you can open any step, see what it does, and explain it to the person who runs it.

howToUse.title: Connect your tools
howToUse.description: The page says to connect n8n to just about any tool, with 500+ native integrations, any API via HTTP, and MCP.

howToUse.title: Self-host if you need to
howToUse.description: The homepage says you can self-host your AI stack, and deploy on-prem or with Docker.
